supersedes.correction: The prior statement that the line-data and MT_CKD assets were unavailable locally was wrong. Existing authenticated private staging and an executed held-state input record show both assets and their exact path pins. The original plan is preserved unchanged.

scope: One future official v12.17 example regression against bundled radiance/temperature references; this is not an OD-only reference, WRF validation, UDM validation, or general accuracy claim.

tape5.case: 1000-1200 cm-1 built-in US standard atmosphere, nadir from 100 km to surface, IEMIT=1

aer_line_file.use_restriction: Private stage only; AER research-use/acknowledgment restrictions apply. Do not redistribute the line-data asset.

gnu_double_precision_lblrtm.qualification: Use only after fresh preflight confirms current source/config/runtime-library closure and binary hash; an old build receipt is not a new run authorization.

existing_held_state_crosscheck.qualification: This confirms the exact local continuum file is staged, hash-pinned, and included in a 38-item runtime input inventory for a separate held-state case. It does not assert that the official built-in example used this file or that a symlink alone proves it was read. The held-state plan's mt_ckd_data role comment conflicts with its ICNTNM=1 controls and should not be reused as evidence of continuum use.

future_run_plan.staging: Copy only selected example TAPE5/reference members into a new empty private case, preserving original hashes. Use the authenticated local AER 3.8.1 source and MT_CKD 4.3 file by their staged path/hash pins. Resolve the example's external TAPE3-link contract in a new explicit input manifest; do not follow the archive's symlink while unpacking.
future_run_plan.line_file_generation: Generate only the IR TAPE3 from the archive's small run_lnfl.pl source and its TAPE5_ir_nlte with pinned LNFL v3.2 and AER v3.8.1 inputs; record generated TAPE3 hash and all controls. Existing TAPE3 from the held-state/custom-band run is not silently substituted as the official example line file.
future_run_plan.run: Use the existing pinned v12.17 GNU-double LBLRTM executable only after source/executable/config/runtime-library hashes and selected TAPE5, line-file, continuum, and cross-section inputs are independently verified before and after. Do not execute the package Perl scripts.
future_run_plan.comparison: Compare complete TAPE27/TAPE28 numeric tabulations against exact archive members. PLTLBL source FORMAT is (3X,F15.8,4X,1P,G19.8E3), so the prospective gate is equality after parsing and rounding both sides to the archived 8-decimal coordinate and 8-significant-digit dependent-value serialization. Retain bytewise file comparison and report unmodified header/date differences; no wider absolute/relative tolerance is authorized.
